description: Active Azure Synapse Spark notebook to Microsoft Fabric mapping configuration. Loaded when the converter starts; use --config to supply another file. Environment-specific mappings are empty by default.

implementation_notes.rules.py: Compiles the regex rules below and resolves the allowlisted handlers (key_vault_secret, key_vault_secret_ls, run_notebook, env_context). JSON contains no executable Python.
implementation_notes.converter.py: Splits notebooks into cells, resolves cell magics, applies configured path and table mappings, then applies the rules line by line.
implementation_notes.reader.py: Reads Synapse Studio .ipynb exports and Synapse workspace/Git notebook JSON artifacts.

magic_commands.title: %%csharp (.NET for Spark) cell
magic_commands.message: .NET for Spark (C#/F#) is not supported in Fabric. Rewrite the cell in PySpark or Scala.

magic_commands.title: %%configure session settings
magic_commands.message: Supported session options and defaults differ from Synapse. Verify each setting, or move pool and Spark settings to a Fabric Environment.

magic_commands.title: Unsupported cell magic
magic_commands.message: No Fabric equivalent is known for this cell magic. Migrate the cell manually.

checklist_text.keyvault: Map each Key Vault and linked service to a vault URL and grant the executing identity secret-read access; managed identity for Key Vault is not supported in notebooks.
checklist_text.linkedservice: Fabric has no linked services. Replace linked-service authentication with Key Vault secrets, a service principal, or a Fabric connection.
checklist_text.storage: Re-point Synapse-managed storage and ADLS Gen2 paths to OneLake, shortcuts or abfss URLs, and confirm storage permissions.
checklist_text.lakehouse: Attach a default lakehouse to the notebook (or use fully qualified OneLake names). Lake databases map to lakehouse schemas.
checklist_text.mount: Re-create mount points on Fabric or replace them with OneLake shortcuts.
checklist_text.library: Install libraries through a Fabric Environment; inline %pip and %conda installs are session scoped.
checklist_text.run: Make sure every notebook referenced by %run or notebookutils.notebook.run exists in the Fabric workspace under the converted name.
checklist_text.pool: Decide whether a Fabric Starter pool is sufficient or whether the Synapse Spark pool needs a custom pool or Environment (node size, libraries, Spark properties).
checklist_text.sessionconf: Synapse session settings are not migrated. Re-create driver and executor sizing and Spark properties in a %%configure cell or a Fabric Environment.
checklist_text.sqlconnector: Dedicated SQL pool connector calls need the data in OneLake or a Fabric warehouse; read Delta tables or use the Fabric warehouse connector.
checklist_text.dotnet: .NET for Spark (C#/F#) is not supported in Fabric; rewrite those cells in PySpark or Scala.

rules.title: from notebookutils import mssparkutils -> import notebookutils
credentials.getSecret(vault name, secret) -> Key Vault URL
getSecretWithLS(linked service, secret) -> Key Vault URL
Linked-service credential and TokenLibrary helpers
checklist: Linked-service credential helpers or dynamic secret calls remain.
rules.message: Not converted automatically (linked services, dynamic or multi-line arguments). Use notebookutils.credentials.getSecret(<Key Vault URL>, <secret name>), or a service principal or Fabric connection.

rules.title: mssparkutils.credentials.getToken -> notebookutils
rules.message: Token audience names can differ in Fabric; verify the audience (for example storage or pbi) and the returned scopes.

rules.title: Unsupported mssparkutils.env API
rules.message: No direct equivalent. Use notebookutils.runtime.context to read workspace, notebook, lakehouse and run information.

rules.title: mssparkutils.fs mount APIs
checklist: Mount point usage: confirm the source URL, authentication and mount point on Fabric.
rules.message: Mount arguments and authentication differ in Fabric (no linked services). Prefer OneLake shortcuts or abfss paths.

rules.title: mssparkutils.notebook.run
checklist: notebook.run call: the referenced notebook must exist in the Fabric workspace.
rules.message: Fabric addresses notebooks by name, not by folder path. Verify the notebook name, timeout and arguments.

rules.title: spark.catalog.listDatabases()
rules.message: Fabric does not support this catalog API. The replacement returns a DataFrame instead of a list of Database objects.

rules.title: spark.catalog.getDatabase(name)
rules.message: Fabric does not support this catalog API. The replacement returns a DataFrame instead of a Database object.

rules.title: Unsupported spark.catalog API
rules.message: This catalog API is not supported in Fabric. Use Spark SQL (SHOW DATABASES, SELECT CURRENT_DATABASE(), DESCRIBE DATABASE) or remove the call.

rules.title: Linked-service based configuration
checklist: Linked-service authentication is used by Spark configuration.
rules.message: Linked services do not exist in Fabric. Use direct endpoint authentication, a service principal (ClientCredsTokenProvider) with secrets from Key Vault, or a Fabric connection.

rules.title: Synapse dedicated SQL pool connector
checklist: Dedicated SQL pool connector calls remain.
rules.message: Replace with Delta reads after the data is available in OneLake, or use the Fabric warehouse connector with three-part names.

rules.title: Azure Data Explorer (Kusto) Synapse connector
checklist: Kusto connector uses Synapse linked-service authentication.
rules.message: Remove the linked-service option and pass an accessToken from notebookutils.credentials.getToken(<cluster URL>).

rules.title: Azure Cosmos DB connector
checklist: Cosmos DB account key should come from Key Vault.
rules.message: Use a direct endpoint and read the account key from Key Vault with notebookutils.credentials.getSecret.

rules.title: Synapse-managed storage path
rules.message: Replace with a OneLake path (abfss://<workspace>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<item>/...) or a shortcut path.

rules.title: External storage path
checklist: External ADLS or Blob storage paths are used.
rules.message: Access previously relied on the Synapse workspace identity or a linked service. Create a OneLake shortcut, configure the path in path_mappings, or confirm Fabric authentication to the account.

rules.title: Synapse mount path (synfs)
rules.message: Mount points are not migrated. Re-create the mount in Fabric or use a shortcut.

rules.title: %pip / %conda retained
checklist: %pip or %conda install is session scoped in Fabric; use an Environment for production.
